punchline: They swept out the pigeon droppings and the hiss stayed: it was the afterglow of the Big Bang.
thirty_sec: In 1964-65 Penzias and Wilson could not get rid of a steady excess of noise in Bell Labs' Holmdel horn antenna; after clearing out pigeons and taping joints it remained, and it matched Princeton's prediction of Big Bang radiation.
question: Which small, stubborn anomaly in your work have you been explaining away, and what have you actually ruled out?
key_contrast: Do not dismiss the noise or crown it; rule things out until something real remains.
